name: Kansai International Airport

runway.v: two runways: A 3,500 m and B 4,000 m (B opened 2 Aug 2007); widths not given

notes: The Japan AIP (AIS Japan) needs a log-in and was not read; only the MLIT Civil Aviation Bureau page on Kansai (undated, content suggests about 2013) was used. It says KIX is 'the first 24-hour operated international airport in Japan'; no curfew is recorded because the source does not use those words. An MLIT business-jet promotion paper of Feb 2012 (https://www.mlit.go.jp/common/000192237.pdf) said slots and stands had spare capacity at any time, but it is too old to record as a current slot rule. CIQ (customs) hours for business jets were not found in an official source. IATA code KIX is shown on the MLIT page.
